task.title: 选择 Firefox 架构通道
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Choose between Firefox ESR 140.12 and Firefox Release 152 before importing, validating, or editing a profile.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Start this task before creating a profile, importing policies.json, or validating a raw JSON document.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. The schema channel decides which Firefox policies BPM can validate and which controls are shown as supported. ESR 140.12 is the default long-support channel; Release 152 is the current mainstream channel and includes newer policy controls such as AIControls and VisualSearchEnabled.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Compare the target browser fleet with the supported channels: ESR 140.12 or Release 152.

info.p: 预期结果：所选架构通道与目标 Firefox 和后续验证匹配。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Choose ESR 140.12 when the profile is intended for the supported Extended Support Release deployment.

info.p: 预期结果：所选架构通道与目标 Firefox 和后续验证匹配。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Choose Release 152 when the profile needs current Release-only controls, including supported AI and visual search policies.

info.p: 预期结果：所选架构通道与目标 Firefox 和后续验证匹配。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明架构通道工作流：选择 Firefox 架构通道. Validate after choosing the channel and before saving, export, or handoff.

info.note: 警告：保存或导出前请检查架构通道和验证错误。

result.p: 继续处理配置文件前，架构通道和验证状态已经明确。 The profile uses the schema channel that matches the intended Firefox deployment.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请确认通道、检查 affected policy path，并打开相关主题。 Recovery: if validation reports unsupported, unavailable, deprecated, or unknown settings, confirm the schema channel before editing policy values.
